## What's new

- Miuix OS4 Glass brings redesigned bars, menus, dialogs, and search across HyperLPA. Choose the Miuix floating bottom bar in Appearance.
- First-time setup walks you through connecting a reader and choosing what appears on your Profiles page. You can set up a reader later.
- The About page keeps the full-color app icon, and headers blend into the page as you scroll, including when blur is off.

## Fixes

- Pages open with less stutter. You can open another page during a transition or swipe back again before the first swipe animation ends.
- The Notifications overflow menu no longer leaves its three-dot icon on screen when opening Notification alerts or Remote devices.
- Message menus stay attached to the right row when the list changes.
